progressive_validation_learning_loop.purpose: collect reviewable paper and signal samples so the system can improve from roughly 60% learning quality toward 80%+ calibrated probabilities over repeated runs

mood_to_pool_behavior.risk_off_rebound_watch: contract width, keep open symbols monitored, raise liquid core floor, cap high-beta/meme/new-mover exposure, allow only small paper rebound watch after all gates
mood_to_pool_behavior.risk_on_momentum: expand width, increase high-beta/liquid momentum/new-mover slots, preserve core anchors, allow fresh confirmed catalysts into watch/paper evaluation
mood_to_pool_behavior.selective_high_beta_rotation: modestly expand width toward volume acceleration, high-beta dynamic movers, recovery queue, and confirmed narratives while preserving liquid anchors
mood_to_pool_behavior.mixed_selective: keep balanced width across core, large-cap/infra, high-beta, market movers, and confirmed catalyst names

atmosphere_to_scan_rebalance.risk_appetite_accelerating: increase effective width and high-beta/liquid momentum quota only when 24h breadth is not risk-off
atmosphere_to_scan_rebalance.risk_appetite_fading: reduce effective width, cut meme/high-beta quota, and require stronger independent current-signal evidence
atmosphere_to_scan_rebalance.rebound_attempt: keep rebound candidates visible but classify them as watch or minimum-size paper only until 4h confirmation improves
atmosphere_to_scan_rebalance.pullback_after_strength: avoid late-chase expansion; preserve leaders and raise liquidity/current-signal thresholds

sentiment_to_pool_behavior.positive_catalyst_cluster: reserve social-catalyst watch slots and boost social-long ranking only when handoff is fresh
sentiment_to_pool_behavior.risk_alert_cluster: contract high-beta/meme/social-catalyst slots, raise core/liquid floors, and downgrade affected names unless price/liquidity/current-signal evidence independently passes
sentiment_to_pool_behavior.light_positive_context: small ranking boost only; no width expansion
sentiment_to_pool_behavior.neutral_or_missing_social: ignore social expansion and rank from market breadth, liquidity, movement, participation, and recovery queue

paper_exit_management.purpose: simulate API-like sell decisions quickly enough to test monthly-double paper target without real orders

paper_recent_loss_quality_gate.purpose: after a recent same-symbol paper loss, require materially stronger evidence before reopening the same exploratory or validation mode

validation_recovery_plan_gate.purpose: consume validation_recovery_plan before future paper entries so retired/cooldown groups cannot keep damaging the monthly-double paper ledger
validation_recovery_plan_gate.quality_scout_weak_interval_retest_note: Only current_signal_quality_scout_probe may retest a weak interval at minimum paper size; weak symbols, retired entry modes, and retired strategy families still block and take priority over the weak-interval exception.

paper_recent_loss_rotation.purpose: turn recent failed paper trades into candidate-ranking penalties so idle cash rotates toward different high-liquidity symbols instead of repeatedly probing the same loser

paper_recent_strategy_loss_rotation.purpose: penalize candidate ranking when the same strategy family, interval, and paper entry mode recently failed, even on a different symbol

schedule.purpose: fast review of open paper positions so exits can be simulated without waiting for full strategy scans

validation_progress_runner.purpose: orchestrate pre-audit, paper exit review, fast paper scan, optional daily deep scan, and post-audit so validation evidence gaps are tracked run by run
validation_progress_runner.recommended_deep_pass: run with --include-daily when time/network budget allows

optional_refresh_steps.include_dynamic_kline_cache: fetches public Binance spot klines for high-liquidity/high-movement USDT pairs before walk-forward/current-signal refresh
optional_refresh_steps.include_walkforward_refresh: persists a fresh weekly-goal evidence JSON before post-audit
optional_refresh_steps.include_current_signal_probe: persists a fresh current-signal evidence JSON before post-audit
optional_refresh_steps.include_strategy_recovery_optimizer: persists a paper-only recovery queue after retired/cooldown strategy groups are filtered out

validation_progress_runner.quality_scout_sampler_note: When validation capacity pauses ordinary new samples, the runner may still call current_signal_near_miss_sampler.py --quality-scout-only to collect minimum-size forward evidence for strict current-signal quality scouts. Duplicate sample keys, weak symbols, retired entry modes, retired strategy families, liquidity, cash, and live-order safety gates still block entries.

pause_resume_guard.purpose: after paused automation or stale open positions, force a review-first runner pass before any new paper entries so stale ledger data cannot drive fresh risk

resume_preflight.purpose: read-only preflight before resuming paused hourly paper automation

safety_invariant_auditor.purpose: offline scan for live order flags, private Binance endpoints, signing/private API markers, and known API key leaks before resuming automation

strategy_recovery_optimizer.purpose: when validation losses retire or cooldown old entry modes, combine latest walk-forward evidence with validation_recovery_plan to produce a research-only queue of future small-paper retest candidates

current_signal_near_miss_sampler.purpose: open tiny paper-only forward samples for current-signal near misses when validation sample size is still insufficient

kline_cache_freshness.purpose: prevent hourly paper scans from treating stale Binance kline cache files as current signals

paper_dynamic_sizing.purpose: increase simulated capital utilization only when evidence, liquidity, and risk gates support it

paper_scale_in.purpose: paper-only controlled pyramiding into existing winners when cash is idle and the same symbol remains the only fast signal

paper_entry_mode_learning_guard.purpose: auto-learn from realized paper outcomes and block entry modes that are currently hurting the monthly-double paper objective

validation_probe.cooldown_reason: latest validation_probe sample failed after realistic spread/slippage/fee costs

current_signal_validation_probe.cooldown_reason: current signal validation samples are 0% win rate in the latest audit

current_signal_quality_scout_probe.cooldown_reason: quality scout requires its own realized paper history before larger sizing

current_signal_near_miss_probe.cooldown_reason: near-miss samples are 0% win rate in the latest audit

winner_scale_in_probe.cooldown_reason: scale-in samples currently reduce expectancy and need fresh proof before reuse

info_exploratory_probe.cooldown_reason: info exploratory mode remains allowed only while realized paper evidence stays positive

strict_strategy_gate.cooldown_reason: strict gate remains allowed unless realized evidence turns negative
